input_types: UTF-8 JSON stdin object with schema_version toolbox-noaa-sf6-source-surface-comparison-input-r0 and exactly integer start_year/end_year (1998–2100 inclusive; at most 50 years); caller-supplied URLs and extra fields are rejected.
required_outputs: For each requested year, provider-reported annual atmospheric SF6 mole-fraction increase and uncertainty in ppt from both fixed surfaces, exact arithmetic differences, and explicit missing-year status.
Two fixed-source receipts with retrieval timestamps, HTTP status and available validators, response byte counts and SHA-256 digests, plus request count and claim ceiling.
